instructions: SECTION 4 · You will hear part of a lecture about Roman concrete.

groups.instructions: Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.
groups.strategy: Look at the words just before and after each gap: they are usually paraphrased, not repeated exactly. E.g. note 'weak at first' ← lecturer 'much weaker … when it's first made'.

questions.prompt: Ingredients: lime + volcanic ash from near Pozzuoli, close to the city of ________.
Bulk made up of chunks of rock or broken ________.
Pantheon dome: world's largest ________ concrete dome.
questions.explanation: 'the largest unreinforced concrete dome in the world'. Hyphen-free single word.

questions.prompt: Lighter rock called ________ used near the top.
questions.explanation: 'they used lighter volcanic rock, called pumice'.

questions.prompt: Marine concrete: seawater reacted with ash to form ________ that strengthen it.
questions.explanation: 'form new minerals, including rare crystals that grow in the gaps and reinforce the material'.

questions.prompt: White lumps result from mixing lime while it is ________.
questions.explanation: 'mixing the lime while it was still hot'.

questions.prompt: Lime fills cracks, so the concrete can ________ itself.
questions.explanation: 'The concrete, in effect, repairs itself.' Note the base form is needed after 'can'.

questions.prompt: Disadvantage: takes a long time to reach full ________.
questions.explanation: 'it takes a long time to reach full strength'.

questions.prompt: Roman lime made at lower ________, so less energy needed.
Self-healing mixtures being tested for sea ________.
